'''Mike Kessling Givin a blow''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Mike Kessling]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-1731">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/1731 Givin a blow], DeckTech (Michael "Troop1023" Kessling, 18 December 1999). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/1731/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/1731/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018220023/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/1731/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mike Kessling]]
* '''Published:''' 18 December 1999 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Givin a blow''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|Endor-L-rebelstriketeam.gif|label=Rebel Strike Team}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor RST Kessling LS 1999 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This deck blows up the shield as a side objective. It is made as a fun mains deck, instead of just being just plane old Hutt/Tosche.

== Original post ==

'''Givin a blow'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "Troop1023" Kessling
* '''Published:''' December 18, 1999
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This deck blows up the shield as a side objective. It is made as a fun mains deck, instead of just being just plane old Hutt/Tosche.

=== Strategy ===

I know, i thought this OBJ Blew (pun intended) too. But I built this deck, and now I am not soo sure. The main purpose is to fight with the mains. Im sure you all know how to do it.

I made a mistake in the deck When u review change out an Undercover for an Order to Engage. Also, there are 2 starship lists for some reason. It should be the one with the Redemtion Disregaurd the other.

VS OPS blow the shield with weenies. fight with mains

i think this deck has potential. tell me what u think
